meta.name: Pam Tommy
meta.description: This comedic series takes on the true story behind the release of the first ever viral video in history — the sex tape of Pamela Anderson and Tommy Lee.

videos.title: Drilling and Pounding
videos.overview: Handyman Rand Gauthier seeks revenge on the celebrity client who stiffs him.

videos.title: I Love You, Tommy
videos.overview: Pamela Anderson and Tommy Lee meet, get high, and get married… all in four days.

videos.title: Jane Fonda
videos.overview: Rand teams up with an old porn-world associate to shop the tape around town.

videos.title: The Master Beta
videos.overview: Pam and Tommy resort to increasingly desperate measures to get their property back.

videos.title: Uncle Jim and Aunt Susie In Duluth
videos.overview: The tape falls into the hands of Penthouse publisher Bob Guccione.

videos.title: Pamela in Wonderland
videos.overview: During a grueling deposition, Pam is pushed to the emotional brink.

videos.title: Destroyer of Worlds
videos.overview: Tommy confronts Rand in the Dodger Stadium parking lot.

videos.title: Seattle
videos.overview: A cocky young Internet entrepreneur enters the picture, changing everything.

meta.slogan: The greatest love story ever sold.
